_description: Ambience layer (rain, cafe chatter, etc.). Always loops under everything at low volume.
_how_to_add: Drop a file here named <name>.mp3 (or .wav/.ogg/.flac). Loopable, 60s+ recommended.

_referenced_by_example.cafe_quiet: cozy + funny moods (low cafe murmur, no music)
_referenced_by_example.city_night: city mood (city at night, with distant traffic and occasional sirens)

_ai_replacements.rain_soft_ai: original generated soft rain texture; use as library://ambience/rain_soft_ai
_ai_replacements.cafe_quiet_ai: original generated quiet cafe ambience; use as library://ambience/cafe_quiet_ai
_ai_replacements.rain_window_ai: original generated rain-on-window ambience; use as library://ambience/rain_window_ai
_ai_replacements.people_murmuring_ai: original generated low crowd murmur ambience; use as library://ambience/people_murmuring_ai
_ai_replacements.city_night_ai: original generated city-night ambience; use as library://ambience/city_night_ai
